methodologyNotes: Published self-serve payment-processing pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date; because this vertical prices per transaction (percentage + fixed fee) rather than per seat, the per-transaction rate is recorded in each plan's notes and monthlyUsd holds only a genuine published recurring fee (Authorize.net gateway $25/mo, Square Plus/Premium, Stax subscription) or null when the plan is pure pay-as-you-go with no monthly fee. Quote-only / custom-negotiated tiers and any rate not printed on the fetched page are recorded with monthlyUsd null, and the minutes/calls/overage fields are null throughout since they do not apply to this vertical.

vendors.name: Stripe
vendors.provenance: https://stripe.com/pricing (official; the page geolocated to the EU/EUR for the fetch, so the US online 2.9% + $0.30 and Terminal 2.7% + $0.05 figures were confirmed via stripe.com search results and stripe.com/resources)

plans.name: Integrated (Standard pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Pay-as-you-go online card processing at 2.9% + $0.30 per successful charge. No setup, monthly, or hidden fees. +1% for international cards, +1% for currency conversion. Includes basic dashboard, reporting, and 3D Secure.

plans.name: In-person (Stripe Terminal)
plans.notes: Card-present transactions via Stripe Terminal at 2.7% + $0.05 per successful charge. No monthly fee; reader hardware purchased separately.

plans.name: Customized / Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Volume discounts, interchange-plus (IC+) pricing, multi-product discounts, and country-specific rates negotiated with sales (typically for businesses processing over $100K/month). No published price.

vendors.name: PayPal
vendors.provenance: https://www.paypal.com/us/business/paypal-business-fees (official US merchant fee schedule, last updated May 19, 2026)

plans.name: PayPal Checkout
plans.notes: Standard online checkout / commercial transactions at 3.49% + $0.49 per transaction (USD domestic). +1.50% for international transactions. No monthly fee.

plans.name: Advanced Credit and Debit Card Payments
plans.notes: Advanced (hosted/custom) card processing at 2.89% + $0.29 per transaction (USD domestic). No separate monthly fee, unlike legacy Payments Pro ($30/mo) and Payments Advanced ($5/mo).

plans.name: In-store QR code / Card present
plans.notes: In-person QR code and point-of-sale card-present transactions at 2.29% + $0.09 per transaction (USD domestic).

plans.name: Square Free
plans.notes: No monthly subscription. In-person (tap/dip/swipe) 2.6% + $0.15; online/e-commerce 3.3% + $0.30; invoices (ACH) 1% ($1 min); manually keyed / card-on-file 3.5% + $0.15. Free Square POS software.

plans.name: Square Plus
plans.notes: Paid monthly subscription (varies by product; exact $/mo not printed on the fees page). Lower in-person rate 2.5% + $0.15; online/e-commerce 2.9% + $0.30; invoices (ACH) 1% ($1 min, $10 cap); keyed 3.5% + $0.15. 30-day free trial. monthlyUsd null because the subscription fee is not published on the fetched fees page.

plans.name: Square Premium
plans.notes: Paid monthly subscription (varies by product; exact $/mo not printed on the fees page). Lowest in-person rate 2.4% + $0.15; online/e-commerce 2.9% + $0.30; invoices (ACH) 1% ($1 min, $10 cap); keyed 3.5% + $0.15. 30-day free trial. monthlyUsd null because the subscription fee is not published on the fetched fees page.

vendors.name: Braintree (a PayPal service)
vendors.provenance: https://www.braintreepayments.com/braintree-pricing (official; 301-redirects to https://www.paypal.com/us/enterprise/paypal-braintree-fees, the fetched source of these figures)

plans.name: Standard pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Cards and digital wallets at 2.89% + $0.29 per transaction. Venmo 3.49% + $0.49. PayPal subject to your PayPal account terms. +1% non-USD currency, +1% non-US-issued cards. No monthly, setup, or minimum fees; chargebacks $15.

plans.name: ACH Direct Debit
plans.notes: Standard ACH Direct Debit at 0.75% per transaction (capped at $5.00). Same-day ACH at 1.5% + $0.10. No monthly fee.

plans.name: Custom / Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Custom flat rates, interchange-plus pricing, and discounted volume rates for established businesses, negotiated with sales. No published price. (Registered 501(c)(3) charities get a published reduced rate of 2.19% + $0.29.)

vendors.name: Adyen
vendors.provenance: https://www.adyen.com/pricing (official; interchange++ model with a fixed processing fee, rates labeled indicative on the page)

plans.name: Interchange++ (processing fee + scheme fees)
plans.notes: Per-transaction fixed processing fee of $0.13 plus payment-method fees on an interchange++ basis: Visa/Mastercard/Maestro interchange + 0.60%; American Express 3.30% + $0.10 (North America). No setup, monthly, or closure fees. A minimum monthly invoice applies (amount not published).

plans.name: Custom / Volume
plans.notes: Quote-only. Custom pricing for high volume and for volume-based methods (Boleto, Pix, meal vouchers); published rates are described as indicative. No published price.

vendors.name: Helcim
vendors.provenance: https://www.helcim.com/pricing/ (official interchange-plus pricing with published volume tiers)

plans.name: Interchange Plus (in-person)
plans.notes: In-person markup over interchange, banded by monthly volume: $0-$50K interchange + 0.40% + $0.08; $50K-$100K +0.35% + $0.07; $100K-$500K +0.25% + $0.07; $500K-$1M +0.20% + $0.06; $1M-$5M +0.15% + $0.06. No monthly, setup, PCI, or cancellation fees; no contract.

plans.name: Interchange Plus (keyed & online)
plans.notes: Keyed/online markup over interchange, banded by monthly volume: $0-$50K interchange + 0.50% + $0.25; $50K-$100K +0.45% + $0.20; $100K-$500K +0.35% + $0.20; $500K-$1M +0.25% + $0.15; $1M-$5M +0.15% + $0.15. ACH 0.5% + $0.25 (capped $6). No monthly fee.

vendors.name: Stax (by Fattmerchant)
vendors.provenance: https://staxpayments.com/pricing/ (official; membership/subscription model at 0% interchange markup. The official page returned HTTP 403 on fetch, so per-tier subscription $/mo and per-transaction cents were corroborated via a 2026 pricing review)

plans.name: Subscription (up to $150K/yr)
plans.notes: Membership pricing at 0% markup over direct-cost interchange. For annual processing up to $150K: $99/month subscription plus per-transaction interchange + $0.08 in-person (EMV terminal) or interchange + $0.15 online/keyed. No percentage markup. monthlyUsd corroborated via review since the official page returned 403.

plans.name: Subscription ($150K-$250K/yr)
plans.notes: Membership pricing at 0% markup over interchange. For annual processing $150K-$250K: $139/month subscription plus interchange + $0.08 in-person or interchange + $0.15 online/keyed. monthlyUsd corroborated via review since the official page returned 403.

plans.name: Subscription ($250K+/yr)
plans.notes: Membership pricing at 0% markup over interchange. For annual processing $250K+: from $199/month subscription plus interchange + $0.08 in-person or interchange + $0.15 online/keyed. monthlyUsd corroborated via review since the official page returned 403.

vendors.name: Authorize.net
vendors.provenance: https://www.authorize.net/en-us/sign-up/pricing.html (official published plans; no setup or early-termination fees)

plans.name: All-in-One
plans.notes: $25/month gateway fee plus 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction (Authorize.net acts as both gateway and merchant account). No setup fee.

plans.name: Payment Gateway Only
plans.notes: $25/month gateway fee plus $0.10 per transaction and a $0.10 daily batch fee; you bring your own merchant account. No setup fee.

plans.name: Gateway + eCheck
plans.notes: $25/month gateway fee; credit card $0.10 per transaction + $0.10 daily batch fee; eCheck/ACH processed at 0.75%. No setup fee.
